headline: Shyam Metalics posts 43% rise in Q2 profit to Rs 493 crore, approves new capex
hook: Profit jumps 43% as capex gets nod
summary: Shyam Metalics reported a 43% year-on-year rise in net profit to Rs 493 crore for the second quarter. Revenue from operations grew 9% compared to the same period last year. The board also approved a fresh investment plan in which Shyam Metalics will contribute 51%, amounting to approximately Rs 183.6 crore. The performance highlights sustained operational growth alongside ongoing capital expansion.
why_it_matters: Strong quarterly growth and fresh expansion plans improve medium-term earnings outlook.

headline: Shyam Metalics' unit gets court approval to merge with Shree Venkateshwara Electrocast
hook: Merger could boost Shyam Metalics' capacity
summary: Shyam Metalics and Energy Ltd disclosed that its subsidiary Shyam Sel and Power Ltd has received NCLT sanction to merge with Shree Venkateshwara Electrocast Private Ltd, with the merger deemed effective from April 1, 2024. The approval consolidates metal casting operations under the listed group. The combined entity is expected to achieve operational synergies and broaden its product range. The merger will be reflected in the company's upcoming financial statements.
why_it_matters: Potential synergies may boost future earnings
